thread:
Jules (partnerships): FortiKey Labs reached out about a Redwood marketplace tile + co-announcement. They require SAML IdP metadata exchange, SCIM group provisioning, KMIP/KMS key-wrap (wrapped-only), and a secrets connector with auto-rotate. Proposed public week: Sep 6. Quick volunteers for a sync?
Ava (product): I can lead the demo. Need embargo window and who owns PR.
Rohit (security): Must get attestation report, FIPS statement, and written guarantee that private keys can't be exported unwrapped. Also request audit log access for wrap ops in staging.
FortiKey Rep: We have FIPS-validated modules and an attestation PDF. KMIP: kmip.fortikey.example.com:5696. REST wrap endpoint: https://kms.fortikey.example.com/v1/wrap. Confirmed wrapped-only policy.
Leo (eng): For integration please provide: 1) sample KMIP/REST wrap curl, 2) SCIM base URL + any custom attrs, 3) a short-lived staging tenant for DevX.
FortiKey Rep: SCIM: https://scim.fortikey.example.com/v2. Custom attr: x:device_slot. We'll provision staging creds tomorrow.
DevX (devex): I'll prep SCIM test users and the console runbook. Can LegalBot post an MOU template?
LegalBot: Uploading MOU template now. Recommend 48-72 hour embargo after asset signoff.
Jules (partnerships): Thanks. Calendar hold: Mon Aug 26 10:00am PT for 30m pre-QA sync. calendar-bot: meeting scheduled. Action items: FortiKey -> attestation + staging creds; Eng/DevX -> SCIM mapping + test plan; Legal -> MOU; Product -> demo script.
Ava (product): I'll draft the demo steps and share by EOD Friday.
Rohit (security): I'll review attestation once uploaded and add any additional checkpoints.
FortiKey Rep: Will upload docs and creds to the shared folder tonight. Looking forward to the call.
Jules (partnerships): Perfect 44d will convert actions to a checklist after the sync.
